method.class: Controlled evaluation of heteroscedastic, isometric-logratio split-conformal regions for continuous compositional regression
method.description:
Scientific target: observed positive continuous compositional regression, not classification labels or latent probabilities. Synthetic-only controlled scaled-ILR split conformal; null and negative results valid. Linux x86-64 with Landlock ABI>=3 and libseccomp.so.2 required for native smoke; production uses harness no-network candidate container. Native validation stages only the supplied self-contained entrypoint (<=32MiB), never sibling directories that could contain evaluator data. Candidate implementations must stay self-contained in their entrypoint. Native candidate filesystem is read-only (code and runtime libraries only), with private-data/proc denial, no networking or subprocesses, own-thread-only signals/limits, fixed CPU affinity and no filesystem-persistent state across resets. CPython 3.11 or 3.12 with NumPy 1.26.4 (3.12 actually validated), CPU only. Aggregate 8 cores/16GiB partitioned evaluator4/8GiB and candidate4/8GiB; four BLAS threads and all-thread CPU limits 4800s/role search and14400s/role final; no paid API, GPU, or external asset. Total storage<10GB and one-week research limit. No task-local publication controller or telemetry accessor.
Frozen generator composition-v1 is executable generate_arrays in each evaluator: six features uniform[-1.5,1.5], or shifted TEST only clipped Normal(.8,1) in[-2.5,3]; logistic-normal sigma=.25; Dirichlet conditional concentration 4+35/(1+exp(2*x0)), gamma floor1e-12 then closure; subgroup x0>0 vs<=0. Mean and fixed Helmert ILR basis are in evaluator; conditional law unchanged under shift. Case order LN_IID_K3,LN_IID_K8,DIR_IID_K3,DIR_IID_K8,DIR_SHIFT_K3,DIR_SHIFT_K8, seed-major. Search sizes512/256/1024 train/cal/test; final1024/512/2048;128 frozen contexts,1024 uniform-simplex probes. Smoke first case/seed only,64/32/64 rows,16contexts64probes, same loading/RPC/fitting/scoring/control/aggregation path, <=120s. No replay or auxiliary reset episodes.
Provenance before transformations: canonical shape+schema+finite little-endian float64, negative-zero normalization, SHA256 of X,Y,and concatenated raw example independent of source IDs. Draft audits all204288 examples across planes and roles and rejects overlap; each runtime rechecks its own frozen bytes, source IDs, row provenance, RNG substreams and normalized content. Manifests attest pre-freeze global disjointness without exposing opposite-plane examples/hashes. Shared immutable generator code/basis is not held-out data. Exact structural zero compositions are out of scope; floor convention is part of the raw generator. No text corpus is used.
RPC python_rpc_v1:handle exclusively: reset(seed), predict(X) unfitted probe, fit_center(Xtrain,Ytrain,dimension), fit_scale(), predict(mainX), predict(constantX), predict(permutedX). These are7calls/episode: reset1,unfitted1,fit_center1,fit_scale1,main_prediction1,constant_prediction1,permuted_prediction1. Setup/export/import/chunk/commit/replay counts are zero: no state transfer protocol or arrays beyond the declared bounded inline shapes. Shapes<=4096x8, <=1MiB decoded per array; training/probe/prediction production maxima fit inline. This refines the design's generic 8MiB transfer plan without dropping scientific work: reject larger values rather than invent unnecessary chunk calls. Each complete UTF8 JSON+base64+dtype/shape/byte-order+envelope+newline message<2MiB and strictly<64MiB. Preflight serializes max search/final requests/responses plus4096-row boundary and mock traces; no paths, shared files, heldout labels, baseline outputs, feedback scores or state claims in RPC. Starter model state<64MiB; candidate internals are not independently size-attested beyond the process memory bound8GiB. Exactly126 maximum searchcalls=18*7 and336 finalcalls=48*7. No replay authorized. Counter enforces the same derived totals in each evaluator.
Candidate outputs center[N,K-1] abs<=100 and scale[N,K-1] in[1e-4,100] in declared basis; exact keys and base64 schema validated separately from scientific decisions. Training-only polynomial-ridge center then log residual scale is the lightweight starter. Candidate fitting stages are advisory internal work, not trusted operation counters. Actual evaluator region score max_j|log(y)B-center|/scale. Prediction rows are privately interleaved across calibration/test using a deterministic permutation derived from frozen independent integration probes, identically across matched query arms; only evaluator restores role order. Calibration uses ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha)), inclusive <= ties; rank>n gives full infinite region. alpha.05,.10,.20 equal1/3. No calibration/test targets or sequential score feedback exposed. Search/final scientific validity requires independently formed regions, finite predictions, complete transcript, independent data, successful required baselines/nonvacuous structural controls, and enforced resource/isolation constraints. Search correct and final correct are declared separately but use these same scientific/integrity gates on their own full plane; neither requires superiority, conditional validity, effect sign, empirical coverage threshold or positive utility. A schema-valid candidate assertion is not evidence. Correctness does not approve a publication narrative.
Matched canonical controls each episode: reset->predict must be unfitted; constant training-mean features produce identical row predictions; independent cyclic derangements within calibration and test, no fixed point and at least two genuinely changed feature rows in EACH calibration/test branch, must preserve read-only input/output alignment; zero-radius point at actual predicted simplex center has continuous-noise coverage<.5. Expected feature-control loss of alignment/efficiency is empirical, no required sign and recalibrated IID coverage may remain valid. Missing/failed/vacuous controls fail completion and retain full episode worst case. Main,constant,permuted queries have matched rows, shapes,3s allowances,trained state and no label feedback; controls refit no models and add no resets. Constant or observation-independent conformal predictors remain eligible if structurally valid; no adaptivity gate is imposed. No changed-state hash or self-report gate exists.
Evaluator-owned baseline constructions sharing main candidate centers: unscaled max-ILR residual; simplex L-infinity; genuinely distinct Bonferroni per-coordinate quantiles alpha/K; training-only constant ILR center with unit scales; whole simplex. Baselines and controlled method scores run synchronously with bounded arrays, deadline checks every16 integration contexts,3s/method reservations; no baseline subprocess is needed and no worker telemetry invented. Candidate methods and required controls have reserved matched allowances before fitting. First method unfitted+two fitting calls, three prediction methods, nine scoring methods =13 slots at3s plus.1s overhead/slot. Native terminate.5s+kill/reap.5s+stderr reader.4s <=1.4s, no baseline-worker cleanup;4s episode overhead conservatively covers bookkeeping and cleanup including reset failure. The monotonic clock starts before numerical dependency imports; deadlines subtract startup120s search/180s final (smoke20s), reserve15s finalization, globally reserve3s reset+4s overhead per remaining episode across entire list. Conservative joint plan startup+15+episodes*(3+4+13*3.1) gives986.4s search and2465.4s final, below1200/3600 ceilings. No canonical productive-work floor exists; measured productive baseline work is recorded excluding imports/reset/cancellation/output. Smoke does not attest production completion.
Scoring per alpha: realized JOINT coverage C, common-probe normalized simplex volume V, U=(1-V)*max(0,1-|C-(1-alpha)|/(1-alpha)). Aggregate alpha1/3 then seeds1/3 search or1/8 final within case,dimensions1/2 within family,families1/3. Balanced flattened means are equivalent. No checkpoint/decision levels. Coverage errors are absolute; IID metric uses only LN_IID and DIR_IID equal1/2; shift metric uses DIR_SHIFT. Volume and control check rate follow full hierarchy. Baseline gap is candidate aggregate utility minus max aggregate of unscaledILR/simplexLinf/Bonferroni, descriptive only. All missing/failed episode contributions fixed at utility0,error1,volume1,controls0,correct0, including missing controls/baselines, never omitted/retried/renormalized. Any unavailable baseline comparison sets entire gap=-1. Runtime is not a scalar objective. Failures retain measured actual duration only in evidence. Smoke missing unselected shift family emits fixed error1 diagnostic, not a claimed shift experiment; selected case/seed levels use identity aggregation.
Evidence: validated per-case per-alpha method and control outcomes in per-seed solution, merged over repeated seeds with fixed means and actual total episode duration. Conditional95% Wilson binomial intervals, two feature-defined subgroups; zero-hit volume one-sided95% bound1-.05**(1/probes) and resolution1/probes; common probes imply contexts are not independent experimental replications. Paired percentile bootstrap over independent statistical seeds with PCG64 seed62845,20000 replicates for each case/alpha baseline utility and volume difference;54 predeclared comparisons3baselines*2dimensions*3families*3alphas use Bonferroni simultaneous interval tails .05/(2*54). Overall utility uncertainty resamples statistical seed blocks keeping all cases together; feature-control paired utility differences have seed-bootstrap intervals with no sign gate. Bootstrap is finite-seed empirical uncertainty, not an exact distribution-free superiority proof, especially in3-seed search. Final eight-seed intervals remain limited; unresolved MonteCarlo-scale efficiency differences cannot substantiate superiority. Publication requires appropriate additional analysis and complete paper; executable metrics alone cannot establish literature novelty, conditional guarantees or generalization beyond the generators. Final outcomes stay sealed from search and scaffold tuning.

protocol.promotion_rule: Search eligibility is search correct=true and operational isolation/budget compliance, not a positive baseline gap, effect size or coverage tolerance. Rank eligible candidates only by combined_score, ties by earlier campaign index. At most three search evaluations total (one per idea cycle). Harness owns ranking, byte freeze, dependency attestation and sealed final execution; no task-local controller. Final correct attests complete valid final work, not automatic approval of narrative claims. Negative/null results allowed.

search_proxies.name: synthetic_small_split
search_proxies.preserves: Both dimensions, all three regimes, same actual methods, controls, alphas, quantile/volume calculation, normalization, isolation and hierarchy.
search_proxies.omits: Larger frozen final training/calibration/test sizes, eight independent final seeds, literature novelty and manuscript assessment.

search_visible: The canonical task, public generator families and region definitions, search-only resource specification, permitted training examples/targets, unlabeled calibration/test prediction features, and plane-independent workload settings. No candidate-visible source embeds final seeds or final workload mappings.

After each of at most three campaign search evaluations, expose the declared search metrics and bounded search diagnostics to the optimizer. During an episode return no targets, baseline outputs, coverage, quantiles, metrics, correctness, resource paths, or sealed feedback to the candidate. Search-visible diagnostics never include any final examples or final results.
final_sealed: Final seeds and split manifests before candidate freeze; final calibration/test composition targets, latent generator truth, baseline predictions/results, scoring probes, per-case metrics, uncertainty calculations, and final correctness evidence throughout optimization.

Final scalar results, disaggregated evidence, manuscript claim assessment, and allocation/transcript attestations remain sealed from candidate selection and are released only through the harness publication policy after frozen-candidate evaluation. Candidate RPC sees only the permitted training rows and unlabeled feature queries needed to execute its current episode.

required_evidence: The later scaffold must bind the actual canonical task digest, candidate/edit boundary, independent search/final entrypoints and resource roots, pinned package provenance, generated-data schema, exact reset arrays, complete worst-case RPC ledger, metric formulas/weights, finite failure values, and candidate freeze/selection policy in the standard contract. Synchronize actual SHA-256 values after relevant changes; do not claim any planned artifact, launch, benchmark, or validation already exists.

Provide successful reduced-work smoke records for both independent evaluators offline with empty HOME, using the actual candidate broker, role-local CPU topology, fixed reset transcript, fitting, controls, baselines, calibration, metric serialization, and cleanup. Preflight the largest representative production request and response by complete serialization, including JSON/base64/envelope/framing, and verify every chunk RPC is budgeted and no message reaches 64 MiB. Smoke does not establish full-production throughput or completion; full runs must supply their own evidence.

Supply raw-example normalized SHA-256 manifests, generator and row provenance, source IDs, seeds/substreams, split assignments, and cross-plane/train-calibration-test duplicate audits before transformations. Identify intentional matched control reuse and distinguish immutable shared scientific code from held-out example content. Separate final example realization and secrecy from common public generator specifications.

Provide full 18-episode search records for each evaluated candidate, at most three evaluations total, and 48-episode final records for the frozen winner, with all prescribed resets and controls globally ordered across process restarts/connections. Include candidate-freeze digest, eligible-candidate ranking/tie resolution, baseline success/failure, nonvacuity checks, all missing/failed contributions, fixed aggregation denominators, and exact scalar metrics.json outputs. Never imply failed or omitted episodes succeeded or replace them with surviving-seed averages.

Provide harness-owned monotonic timing, all-thread CPU usage, process isolation, call/message counts, and allocation evidence covering setup, baselines, candidate fitting, predictions, scoring, and cleanup. Explicitly distinguish enforced broker/deadline/CPU limits from advisory candidate-internal fitting/optimizer counts. Candidate-reported counters do not prove hard internal compute bounds; no undocumented memory or telemetry API is assumed. Show the one-week research time and less-than-10-GB storage constraints are respected across the campaign and paper preparation, with zero paid APIs and no GPU requirement.

Document the actual scaled-ILR score/region implementation, positivity convention, basis, quantile rounding/ties, inverse transformation, calibration separation, and the finite-sample marginal coverage argument under exchangeability, alongside evaluator-owned numerical checks. Explain why coordinatewise coverage alone is inadequate, why conditional and shifted coverage are not automatic, and why positive continuous composition results do not establish categorical-label, exact-zero, real-dataset, or latent-probability guarantees.

Report all alpha/dimension/regime results for the actual method and three actual conformal baseline constructions, constant-center and whole-simplex references, paired feature controls, copy-point and reset controls. Include seed-clustered uncertainty, per-episode coverage uncertainty, subgroup results, Monte Carlo volume resolution, multiplicity policy, and failed runs. Comparative claims require their predeclared relevant evidence; otherwise report null, negative, heterogeneous, or unresolved findings without changing search eligibility or fabricating a positive result.

Deliver a complete research paper as PDF and LaTeX using the latest available official NeurIPS template at preparation time, verifying its actual year, page limit, appendix/reference rules, license/source provenance, and required checklist then. Include abstract, introduction, related work, methods, experiments, discussion/limitations, and real consulted references. Provide all code, pinned environment/data instructions, seeds, commands, expected runtimes, and explicit script-to-table/figure mappings. Every reported number and plot must be reproduced by actual retained runs, never by estimates, placeholders, or illustrative invented results. Paper production is a downstream obligation, not part of this plan-only output.

Preserve independent research: consult only permitted background literature and unrelated public material. Do not identify, infer, search for, access, or use the prohibited prior paper, its metadata, mirrors, derivative discussions, or code. If encountered inadvertently, stop reading immediately and document location, circumstances, and extent of exposure without further investigation. No external literature retrieval has been performed by this design; later citations must be authentic and actually consulted.
